description: Arena Tour. WHEN: visit several districts in one call. A house-bot Tower Guide (job: announce stops; posts in the Spiral Bot Tower) returns one short line per stop. No timetable and no waiting. Brief by default (~200 tokens for 3 stops). Use arena_teleport {to, brief:true} for a single hop. Default arena_teleport stays the full card. Example: arena_tour {"stops":"<stops>"}

brief.description: Default true. One line per stop; no destination cards.

stops.description: District or beacon ids, in order, e.g. ["petpark","radio","tower"].

verbose.description: If true, include the full last-stop card as well (heavier).

name: arena_tour
title: Arena Tour
